use_keys: Type it on the keypad below the screen.
card_online: Card payments need an internet connection. Use cash or mobile money.
empty: The basket is empty. Tap a product to add it.
tap_card: Tap the card on the top of the screen, or insert it in the slot at the bottom.
wait_momo: The customer approves on their phone.
wait_card: Reading the card. Do not remove it.
queued_note: No internet. The sale is saved and the request will be sent when the terminal is back online.
failed_note: The payment did not go through. Nothing was charged.
wiped: The owner wiped this device. Nothing can be read from it any more.
locked_by_owner: The owner locked this device. Ask the owner to unlock it.
mgr_needed: This void is above your limit. A manager approves it with their own PIN.
asked_owner: Sent to the owner. The answer appears here.
not_allowed: Only the owner, or a manager for cashiers and stock staff, can do this.
bad_pin: Choose 4 to 8 digits that are not a repeated or running number.
staff_note: Everyone has their own PIN. The owner's own PIN is reset only by online recovery.
receipt_waits: The receipt waits on this device and is sent when it is online.
ln_sync: Sales are waiting to be sent
ln_cash: The cash count is off by {amount}
